events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Thursday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Wednesday snapped the two-day losing streak in which it had given up more than 525 points or 1.2 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 47,940-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Thursday.

events.title: South Korea September Trade Surplus $49.85 Billion
events.description: South Korea posted a seasonally adjusted merchandise trade surplus of $49.85 billion in September, the Customs Office said on Thursday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, shedding almost 55 points or 1 percent in that span. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,675-point plateau and it may take further damage again on Thursday.

events.title: BoJ Tankan: Large Manufacturing Index Improves In Q3
events.description: Large manufacturing in Japan accelerated in the third quarter of 2026, the Bank of Japan's quarterly Tankan Survey of business sentiment showed on Thursday with a diffusion index score of +24.

events.title: Malaysia Bourse May Hand Back Wednesday's Gains
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Wednesday snapped the five-day losing streak in which it had slumped more than 40 points or 2.5 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,650-point plateau although it may head south again on Thursday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May See Renewed Selling Pressure
events.description: The Japan stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day slide in which it had tumbled almost 900 points or 1.3 percent. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 66,750-point plateau although it may tick lower again on Thursday.

events.title: Australia Manufacturing PMI Sinks Into Contraction - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Australia fell into contraction territory in September, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 49.6.

events.title: South Korea Shares May Extend Losing Streak
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, sinking more than 240 points or 3.5 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 6,840-point plateau and it may spin its wheels again on Thursday.

events.title: Bank Of Japan Tankan Survey Due On Thursday
events.description: The Bank of Japan will on Thursday release its quarterly Tankan survey of business sentiment, highlighting a busy day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The large manufacturers index is expected to rise to +25 from+22, while the outlook is tipped to improve to +22 from +17. Large all-industry capex is seen higher by 12.3 percent, up from 11.5 percent.

events.title: New Zealand Building Consents Jump 5.6% In August
events.description: The total number of building permits issued in New Zealand was up a seasonally adjusted 5.6 percent on month in August, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday - coming in at 3,440.

events.title: German Inflation Highest Since December 2023
events.description: Germany's consumer price inflation accelerated for a third month in September to reach its highest level in nearly three years on the back of a surge in energy prices, yet the European Central Bank is likely to seek more evidence to establish second-round effects of the fuel price shock on the real economy before raising interest rates again.

events.title: Canadian Market Headed For Another Weak Close
events.description: After opening marginally higher and advancing a bit further, the Canadian market turned weak on Wednesday as investors stayed cautious amid uncertainty about U.S. and Iran reaching a peace deal.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Weak Note
events.description: The Switzerland stock market pared early gains and closed on a negative note on Wednesday as weak investor sentiment data and higher oil prices weighed.
